scraped.scraped_description: Decentralized tools to build community online. The intercommunal net where communities govern, pool funds and stay safe on their own terms.

name: Papertree
tagline: Interactive tree planting data platform for transparent climate action accountability
political_relevance_summary: Papertree addresses barriers to civic data access and transparency, making public or institutional data more available for accountability, research, and informed civic engagement.

movement_building_utility.notes: Papertree primarily serves as an information resource for researchers, journalists, or analysts working on civic and political issues.

generalizability_notes: High generalizability. Papertree is open source and already deployed across multiple countries/jurisdictions, making replication straightforward for other contexts.
